items.title: ESTIC 2026 brings India's emerging technology priorities to New Delhi
items.text: The Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave runs from 27 to 29 October at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. The Prime Minister is scheduled to inaugurate it at 5:30 p.m. Discussions cover 12 areas, including artificial intelligence, biotechnology, advanced materials, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, climate and ocean sciences. The exhibition is expected to feature about 150 deep-tech startup stalls.

items.title: CBSE summit focuses on school-to-work transition and digital skills
items.text: The Central Board of Secondary Education and the Sahodaya School Complexes of Delhi/NCR are organising the fourth National Summit on Facilitating School-to-Work Transition in New Delhi on 26 and 27 October. School leaders, educators, industry experts and policymakers are discussing digital skills, career guidance and ways to help students move from school education into employment.

items.title: India extends RELIEF support scheme for exporters until March 2027
items.text: The Commerce and Industry Ministry has extended the Resilience & Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation (RELIEF) scheme until 31 March 2027. It is intended to support exporters affected by geopolitical disruptions in West Asia and related shipping and insurance difficulties. Under one component, the Export Credit Guarantee Corporation provides 95% risk coverage for eligible shipments to specified destinations.

items.title: Jharkhand association asks BCCI to review disputed under-19 women's match
items.text: The Jharkhand Cricket Association has lodged a complaint with the Board of Control for Cricket in India after a disputed one-run result in a women's under-19 match against Uttarakhand in Nagpur. Jharkhand alleges that a scorer's error may have affected the result and says the match may have ended in a tie. The report did not include a response from the BCCI.

items.title: India seek to extend their T20I lead against New Zealand in Wellington
items.text: India and New Zealand are scheduled to play the third T20 International on 27 October in Wellington. India leads the five-match series 2–0 after winning the second match by four wickets in Christchurch. Tilak Varma scored an unbeaten 51 from 26 balls in that chase. A win in the third match would give India an unassailable series lead.
